messages:
Mara: FYI customer Shoply is seeing function-call failures after we rolled out updated system examples this morning. 12 charges failed with schema validation errors.
Mara: They say the model returns the function arguments as a string, which our tool layer rejects. Error: "schema_validation_failed: arguments not an object".
Vikram (Support): Can you paste the exact request + model reply you got from the customer?
Mara: Pasting sanitized payload from their repro: 
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-open-7b-instruct",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system", "content": "You are a payments assistant. Example: charge_card -> {\"amount\": \"$100\", \"currency\": \"USD\" }"},
    {"role":"user", "content": "Charge $100 to card ending 4242"}
  ],
  "functions": [{"name":"charge_card","parameters": {"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"integer"},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["amount","currency"]}}]
}
```
Mara: Their model reply (truncated):
```json
{
  "name": "charge_card",
  "arguments": "{\"amount\": \"$100\", \"currency\": \"USD\"}"
}
```
Dave (ML Eng): This looks like classic schema drift caused by system/few-shot examples. The system example embeds a JSON object as a quoted string and includes a dollar sign. The model picks up the pattern and emits the whole object as a string. That explains the parse failure.
Laura (SRE): Customer impact: 12 failed actions, retries are blocked because our validation rejects the string. Also their latency spiked while the handler tried reparsing.
Vikram: Repro steps I used locally: 1) set model=redwood-open-7b-instruct, 2) include system prompt with example containing "$100" and quoted JSON, 3) call functions as defined above. Result: response.name=charge_card, response.arguments is a string.
Vikram: Is it possible this is model drift rather than prompt content? @Dave?
Dave: Confirmed it's the prompt. The few-shot example strongly conditions the model to copy the string-serialized object pattern. Quick mitigation: update system examples to show raw numbers (100) and present the example as a structured object, not as a JSON-in-string. Also remove currency symbol in the example.
Mara: Customer wants ETA and rollback plan. They are asking to pause the prompt release if fix can't land quickly.
Laura: Action: I'll add a lightweight CI check that runs the prompt config against the function schema and fails if the model returns non-object arguments. Also prepare a rollback of the prompt-config change if we can't ship the fix inside 2 hours.
Dave: I'll submit PR to replace the problematic examples and add tests to the prompt harness to check types (amount -> integer). I'll also add a temporary server-side sanitizer in the function-call handler: if arguments is a string, try JSON.parse and coerce numeric strings to integers, logging to tool_arg_parse_errors metric. That will buy time for customers.
Vikram: I'll inform Shoply and coordinate with billing ops to make them aware of the 12 failed charges and ask them to retry after we deploy the patch.
Mara: TL;DR action items: @Dave update examples & add prompt/unit tests, @Laura add CI gate + rollback plan, @Vikram update customer and billing ops, ops-bot start deploy when ready.
ops-bot: deploy kickoff initiated by laura for prompt-config patch — run id #prompt-deploy-231
Mara: Thanks team :thumbsup:
